description: This hour's grid carbon intensity (gCO2/kWh), renewable share and day-ahead power price for a European market, the cleanest window in the next hours and its rank among 15 markets. Without a market: all markets ranked cleanest first. Markets: Germany, United Kingdom, France, Netherlands, Ireland, Italy (North), Spain, Poland, Belgium, Austria, Switzerland, Norway (NO2), Sweden (SE3), Denmark (DK1), Finland.

market.description: Optional market, e.g. "France". Leave out for the ranking.
